theNewGrounds.animeBallTrajectory: the anti-hallucination mechanism (anchor-warp dominance where the source-space warp error is low) treats the post-shot BALL — small, fast, in the goal-mouth motion peak — the same way it treated the hallucinated extra balls: the flow at the ball's site during fast flight is unreliable, the nearest anchor's styled ball (painted where the edit model put it, near the shooter) wins the blend, and the real in-flight ball from the fresh frames is suppressed — the trajectory is flattened back onto the shooter's feet
